listing_hotelShuttleWithDiscrepancyMark.expr: (select coalesce(site.groupName, item.code) + (exists(select Attendance a where documentLine.(document=d and !cancelled and item.code='TOC') and exists(select DocumentLine dl where !cancelled and document=d and item.family.code='transp' and item.code in ('HS', 'OS') and !exists(select Attendance where date=a.date and documentLine.(document=d and !cancelled and (item.code in ('HS', 'OS') or item.family.code='park'))))) ? listing_room1.expr: (select min((site.main ? listing_room2.expr: (select min((site.main ? '' : site.name + ' - ') + (resourceConfiguration != null ? resourceConfiguration.resource.name : item.name)) from DocumentLine dl where document=d and !cancelled and item.family.code='acco' and (site.name like '%2' or site.name not like '%1' and site.name not like '%Early%' and exists(select DateInfo di where label.en='Whole part 2' and exists(select Attendance a where a.documentLine=dl and a.date>=di.date and a.date<=di.endDate))) group by item order by item.ord limit 1) as Room2

listing_roomOrCampingWithDiscrepancyMark.expr: ((select min(!resourceConfiguration.resource.site.main ? resourceConfiguration.resource.site.name + ' - ' + resourceConfiguration.resource.name : coalesce(resourceConfiguration.resource.name, item.name in ('Camping','Sharing parents tent') ? item.name : null)) from DocumentLine where document=d and !cancelled and item.family.code='acco' and not site.name like '%Early%' group by item order by item.ord limit 1) + (exists(select Attendance a where documentLine.(document=d and !cancelled and item.code='TOC') and exists(select DocumentLine dl where !cancelled and document=d and item.family.code='acco' and !exists(select Attendance where date=a.date and documentLine=dl))) ? listing_shuttle.expr: (select site.code + ' ' + item.code + '  ' + dates from DocumentLine where document=d and !cancelled and item.(family.code='transp' and lower(name) like '%shuttle%' and lower(name) not like '%airport%') limit 1) as Shuttle

listing_sitting.expr: (select min(substring(resourceConfiguration.resource.name, 1, 2)) from DocumentLine where document=d and !cancelled and item.family.code='meals' and resourceConfiguration.name like 'S%' and site.name not like '%Early%' group by item order by (item.code='LUN' ? 0 : item.code='DIN' ? 1 : 2) limit 1) as Sitting

share_owner_numberOfMatesSpecified.expr: oneOrZero(isSet(share_owner_mate1Name)) + oneOrZero(isSet(share_owner_mate2Name)) + oneOrZero(isSet(share_owner_mate3Name)) + oneOrZero(isSet(share_owner_mate4Name)) + oneOrZero(isSet(share_owner_mate5Name)) + oneOrZero(isSet(share_owner_mate6Name))

text.expr: ?lang='de' ? de : ?lang='en' ? en : ?lang='es' ? es : ?lang='fr' ? fr : ?lang='pt' ? pt : ?lang='zhs' ? zhs : ?lang='zht' ? zht : ?lang='vi' ? vi : en
